purpose.title: What is MutualChain for?
purpose.teaser: A private record to show when something was recorded and whether it has changed. See how it can work alongside your company’s systems.
purpose.1.title: What is blockchain?
purpose.1.desc: It is a record arranged in blocks, one after another. Each block carries a digital fingerprint of the previous one. If someone changes an old record, that link breaks and the change becomes visible.
purpose.2.title: What makes it private?
purpose.2.desc: Only authorized participants can read and record information. On public networks such as Bitcoin, anyone can participate.
purpose.3.title: How does it help a business?
purpose.3.desc: It helps show when a contract, transaction or document was recorded and whether its contents have stayed the same since then.
purpose.4.title: It does not replace your system
purpose.4.desc: It works with the systems your company already uses, keeping evidence of what needs to be checked.
purpose.5.title: In one sentence
purpose.5.desc: A private blockchain is a record that only people you authorize can access, and where any change becomes visible.
purpose.notary.title: Mutual Cartório
purpose.notary.desc: Mutual Cartório is being implemented. The plan is to group records into batches and store a digital fingerprint of each batch on MutualChain as a reference for checking changes. Complete documents stay off the network; this preview does not yet record this evidence.

needs.title: 5 signs your company needs private infrastructure
needs.subtitle: How many do you recognize in your business?
needs.1.title: Customer data is in spreadsheets and services that no one controls.
needs.1.desc: Why it matters: when data is everywhere, no one is accountable for it.
needs.2.title: You cannot say who accessed sensitive data.
needs.2.desc: Without access logs, there is no way to prove what happened to a piece of information.
needs.3.title: The website or system goes down just when it matters most.
needs.3.desc: Every minute offline means a lost sale and a customer who will not return.
needs.4.title: There is no proof that contracts and documents remain unchanged.
needs.4.desc: When a dispute arises, what counts is what you can prove.
needs.5.title: Each system is with a different provider.
needs.5.desc: Data becomes fragmented, and each provider holds a part of your business.
needs.close: Did you recognize any of these signs? The path starts with three questions: Where is your company’s data? Who can access each piece of it? What happens if the system stops tomorrow?
needs.cta: Mutual creates private infrastructure tailored to your company. Talk to Mutual.
needs.privacy: Your selections stay on this page only. Nothing is sent or tracked.

enterprise.institutional.desc: An enterprise layer for digital assets, settlement, reporting, private networks, consortium governance and security controls, integrated with qualified partners.
enterprise.coverage.note: Reach depends on the partner network and route eligibility. Countries, currencies, limits, timing and responsible parties are confirmed for each corridor before contracting.
enterprise.demo.title: Mutucoin demo: proof without exposing data
enterprise.demo.desc: A safe example of how a sensitive document can create verifiable evidence without being displayed on a public network.
enterprise.demo.step1.title: Synthetic document
enterprise.demo.step1.desc: A fictional sample represents the original file.
enterprise.demo.step2.title: Access policy
enterprise.demo.step2.desc: Purpose and authorized people are defined before use.
enterprise.demo.step3.title: Cryptographic proof
enterprise.demo.step3.desc: A digital fingerprint checks integrity without publishing the content.
enterprise.demo.step4.title: Auditable record
enterprise.demo.step4.desc: Evidence records the version and time for later review.
enterprise.demo.note: This demonstration is read-only, presents public data and sends no files, personal data, funds, orders or transactions.
enterprise.final.title: Design the project before connecting operations
enterprise.final.desc: We map purpose, data, jurisdiction, partners, risks and required evidence for a controlled deployment.
enterprise.teaser.title: Data protection and enterprise infrastructure
enterprise.teaser.desc: Explore options for government, finance, health, foreign trade and critical operations.
enterprise.roles.title: Clear responsibilities at every layer
enterprise.roles.desc: Mutucoin, Mutual and licensed partners operate in separate, verifiable roles.
enterprise.role.mutucoin.title: Mutucoin and MutualChain
enterprise.role.mutucoin.desc: Digital proofs, traceability and verifiable records for the flows defined in the project.
enterprise.role.mutual.title: Mutual technology
enterprise.role.mutual.desc: Software, APIs, connectors, controls and organization of integration records.
enterprise.role.partner.title: Licensed partners
enterprise.role.partner.desc: Execution of financial, foreign exchange and settlement operations under their own authorizations and responsibilities.
enterprise.journey.title: From need to activation, with control
enterprise.journey.desc: Each stage produces decisions and evidence before moving forward.
enterprise.journey.step1.title: Understand the context
enterprise.journey.step1.desc: Map purpose, data, people, countries, risks and applicable rules.
enterprise.journey.step2.title: Compose the solution
enterprise.journey.step2.desc: Select the required modules, partners, controls and responsibilities.
enterprise.journey.step3.title: Integrate and validate
enterprise.journey.step3.desc: Test access, records, limits, recovery and expected behavior.
enterprise.journey.step4.title: Activate what was approved
enterprise.journey.step4.desc: Release only the contracted, validated and monitored scope.
enterprise.trust.title: Transparency that follows the technology
enterprise.trust.desc: Mutual best practices applied to Mutucoin: real status, protected access, controlled documents and a reporting channel.
enterprise.trust.status.title: Status always visible
enterprise.trust.status.desc: Each feature states whether it is available, being implemented, or subject to validation and contract.
enterprise.trust.access.title: Protected access as a requirement
enterprise.trust.access.desc: Authenticated areas must use a password, two-step verification and new-device confirmation before activation.
enterprise.trust.governance.title: Versioned documents
enterprise.trust.governance.desc: Policies, terms and statements appear as published only after responsible approval.
enterprise.trust.report.title: Security reporting channel
enterprise.trust.report.desc: Suspected fraud, misuse or vulnerabilities must reach the official channel for review and response.
enterprise.layers.title: One architecture, four control layers
enterprise.layers.desc: Applications, networks, integrations and governance organized so business and technology share the same view.
enterprise.layer.applications.title: Enterprise applications
enterprise.layer.applications.desc: Traceability, verifiable documents, tokenization and digital flows defined for each use case.
enterprise.layer.network.title: Networks and proofs
enterprise.layer.network.desc: Permissioned private, hybrid or public-proof options selected for privacy, scale and participants.
enterprise.layer.integration.title: Integration and operational view
enterprise.layer.integration.desc: APIs, events, existing systems and service-status monitoring in an organized view.
enterprise.layer.governance.title: Security and governance
enterprise.layer.governance.desc: Identities, permissions, keys, approvals, audits, continuity and change rules.
enterprise.layers.note: Technologies, networks, providers and service levels are defined and evidenced for each project before activation.
enterprise.mascot.title: A visual guide to the Mutucoin experience
enterprise.mascot.desc: The 3D mascot makes security, privacy and global infrastructure easier to understand while keeping important information clear and verifiable.
enterprise.mascot.alt: Blue and gold Mutucoin 3D mascot giving a thumbs-up
enterprise.mascot.caption: Visual concept for the Mutucoin presentation.
enterprise.mascot.role.title: Clear guidance
enterprise.mascot.role.desc: Helps present features, status and next steps in plain language.
enterprise.mascot.security.title: Security first
enterprise.mascot.security.desc: Reinforces care with identity, access, data and confirmation before each operation.
enterprise.mascot.identity.title: Consistent identity
enterprise.mascot.identity.desc: Connects the site areas with the same blue and gold visual presence.
enterprise.mascot.note: The mascot is a visual and educational resource. It does not represent automated support, approval, asset safeguarding or financial execution.
